subject: Next steps: shortlist evidence, perf links & regression safety plan
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: shortlist + perf evidence + next steps

Hi Alex — great to connect today. Thanks for walking through ClearWave's ingestion & triage flow; a few quick items and the recommended next steps from our side: 

Summary (1-line): ClearWave is a strong pilot candidate for Redwood Dedicated for clinical summarization with strict latency SLAs and tight QA/regression guards.

Key recommendations
- Shortlist models to evaluate in pilot: redwood-raven-7b-q3b (cost-efficient), redwood-talon-13b-8k (higher-coverage, moderate cost).
- Baseline perf evidence shared below: Redwood-verified profiles include TPS (concurrent reqs at 8k context) and latency percentiles for a 32-token generation.

Redwood-verified snapshot (attached CSV & linked report):
- redwood-raven-7b-q3b: TPS @ steady-state = 22 req/s, p50=42ms, p95=128ms, p99=210ms (single GPU, batch=8)
- redwood-talon-13b-8k: TPS @ steady-state = 9 req/s, p50=96ms, p95=275ms, p99=410ms (single GPU, batch=4)

What I'm attaching/links:
- clearwave_eval_report_v1.pdf — end-to-end perf traces + trace-level latency p50/p95/p99 per model
- prompt_set_clinical_qc_v1.jsonl — example prompt sets we recommend running for regression checks
- redwood_verified_profiles.csv — compact profile table (model, tps, p50/p95/p99, batch hints)
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bCW-eval-pack

Proposed next steps
1) Quick confirmation from you on pilot scope (23k weekly requests? or 100k monthly?).
2) We run a 48-hour pilot with the two models above using a subset of your clinical prompts and our auto-batching. We’ll surface a TPS runbook and per-route SLOs.
3) Procurement: Ben will follow up with an estimated committed capacity and pricing options; Monica will own regression guardrails and SLA acceptance criteria.

Small ask: can you share a sanitized sample (<=100MB) of typical conversational context so we can pre-run the prompt set? If procurement needs an initial quote I’ll loop Ben.

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: clearwave_eval_report_v1.pdf, prompt_set_clinical_qc_v1.jsonl, redwood_verified_profiles.csv

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@clearwave.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearwave.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: shortlist + perf evidence + next steps

Camila — thanks for the thorough recap and the data. Quick notes:

- Appreciate the Raven/Talon split; cost vs coverage tradeoff looks sensible.
- We're leaning toward the raven-7b candidate initially to validate throughput and integration. Primary constraint: p95 latency must stay <300ms for our triage API under the pilot load.
- Procurement: we'll need a ballpark cost + committed capacity to evaluate internally.

I can share a sanitized 50MB sample by end of day Monday (HIPAA-scrubbed). Also looping procurement on the quote request.

One question: do you recommend enabling Redwood's KV prefix cache for our use case (many shared conversation prefixes)? Will that materially change the TPS figures in the verified profiles?

Best,
Alex

On Thu, Feb 11, 2027 at 3:03 PM Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see message above)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@clearwave.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@clearwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: shortlist + perf evidence + next steps

Alex — thanks for the signal. Quick pricing/operational note to help procurement:

- Pilot estimate (48 hours, 40 concurrent users sim, ~100k tokens/day):
  - Option A (Raven-7b-q3b, Redwood Dedicated, small pool): estimated $3,500 for pilot capacity + $0.12 /k token during test runs.
  - Option B (Talon-13b-8k, dedicated medium): estimated $9,800 for pilot capacity + $0.18 /k token during test runs.

- KV prefix cache: enabling prefix cache typically increases effective TPS by ~1.6x for workloads with repeated conversation context; our verified_profiles.csv includes batch=8 numbers WITHOUT cache. If you enable cache we can run a quick configured rerun and update the Drive report with cache-augmented TPS and p95.

What I need from Procurement to generate an initial PO-ready quote:
1) Expected committed concurrency or monthly tokens target (pick one).
2) Billing entity & contact (email for invoicing).

I'll prepare a simple PO-ready line item PDF once we have those details. Camila — happy to join your next call to walk procurement through options.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0224

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@clearwave.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: shortlist + perf evidence + next steps

Alex — quick note on regression safety & acceptance criteria (attached prompt set + checklist):

We recommend the following minimal regression guardrails for the pilot:
- Run the provided prompt_set_clinical_qc_v1.jsonl against both models and compare: accuracy delta, hallucination flags, and entity extraction F1.
- Set automatic rollback threshold: any model with >6% degradation in entity F1 or a >4% rise in hallucination flag rate over baseline triggers a canary rollback.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 300ms (must be met for 95% of routes in the pilot).
- Quality monitoring: daily regression report (we will provide a template in Drive) and an alert to your on-call if regressions exceed thresholds.

I'll attach the checklist and a short runbook. If you want, we can run the KV-cache-enabled rerun and append a cache-augmented profile to redwood_verified_profiles.csv — let me know and we'll schedule the run (typically 12-24h).

Thanks — Monica

--
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Reliability & Evals, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
